signals.spectral_flatness: mean spectral flatness (Wiener entropy) of the prompt
signals.noise_floor_dbfs: mean energy of the quietest 10% of 25 ms frames, dBFS
signals.prompt_utmos: UTMOS (utmos22_strong) of the prompt; one extra non-TTS network pass
signals.prompt_duration_s: prompt duration, seconds (input difficulty, not quality)
signals.target_words: number of words in the target text

templates.gate_to_step4: safe -> Step 4 (proposal's SNR-only rule, Table 3.8), else Step 8

question_1_gate.auc_target: Step-5 failure, all development utterances (clean + noisy15)

question_2_stopping.gate: snr_energy >= 20 dB (fixed, as in the proposal)

signals.drift: PROPOSAL: d_i = ||x1(t_i) - x1(t_i-1)|| / ||x1(t_i)|| over generated frames (Eq. 3.8)
signals.frame_max_drift: max over generated frames of per-frame relative drift
signals.velocity_norm: RMS of the guided velocity over generated frames

question_2_stopping.template: Definition 3.4: first i in (4, 5, 6) with score_i <= lambda, else Step 8
question_2_stopping.auc_target: Step-4 failure among gated development utterances, score at step 4

ltt_justification.policy: proposal policy: SNR gate 20 dB + drift stopping rule (Definition 3.4)
ltt_justification.pool: calibration + test speakers, random speaker-disjoint 50/50 re-splits (calibrate on one half, check on the other)

methods.naive: most aggressive lambda whose calibration risk is <= alpha (no guarantee)
methods.hoeffding: fixed-sequence test with Hoeffding p = exp(-2n(alpha - R)^2)
methods.ltt_binomial: PROPOSAL: fixed-sequence test with exact binomial p = P(Bin(n, alpha) <= k)

ltt_justification.monotonicity_check: on the full calibration split: does robust risk ever decrease as lambda increases?

label_sources.gpu: colab/results/gpu_grid_all1000.csv (same labels as Q1 and Q2)
label_sources.cpu: phase2/phase3 CPU grids (the labels behind the original lambda-hat = 0.50 calibration)

protocol.orientation_rule: chosen on development only: the direction in which the signal predicts failure (AUC >= 0.5)
protocol.threshold_grid_rule: development quantiles q = 0, 0.05, ..., 1, ordered from conservative to aggressive

ltt.test: fixed-sequence binomial, P(Bin(n, alpha) <= k) <= delta

protocol.risk: robust per speaker: a speaker fails if either the clean or the noisy15 utterance fails

verdict_rule.JUSTIFIED: proposal signal is certified on calibration and safe on test (risk <= alpha), and no alternative of equal or lower cost class is safe on test with mean NFE lower by > 0.5
verdict_rule.MATCHED: an alternative of equal or lower cost class is safe on test with |delta NFE| <= 0.5
verdict_rule.OUTPERFORMED: an alternative of equal or lower cost class is safe on test with mean NFE lower by > 0.5
verdict_rule.FAILS_GUARANTEE: proposal signal exceeds alpha on test

protocol.caveat: post-hoc validation: the test split was inspected in earlier analyses
